title: Read external mailbox messages without modifying the mailbox
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a publication user, I want a read-only external IMAP or POP3 Monitor connection, so that newsletters and submissions can be evaluated without changing my mailbox.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Read external mailbox messages without modifying the mailbox
  Scenario: Read permitted messages
    Given an external mailbox connection is separately authorized and configured for a publication or user
    When the email Monitor reads new or updated messages using the selected protocol
    Then only permitted messages are extracted into scoped common intake
    And the connection does not delete, move, send, alter flags or otherwise mutate mailbox state
    And message identity, source mailbox scope, checkpoints and observation provenance permit deduplicated retries
  Scenario: Access or protocol guarantees are unavailable
    Given access is revoked or a protocol/library cannot meet the agreed read-only contract
    When collection is attempted
    Then the connection reports the limitation or failure visibly
    And it does not silently broaden access or perform destructive protocol actions
```

IMAP and POP3 are design options, not claimed equivalent implementations. Specify non-mutating retrieval, credential storage, consent, mailbox/folder scope, retention and retry semantics before connection. No connection or credentials requested now.
